Fresnillo Names Rodrigo Sandoval as Next CFO
By Aimee Look
Fresnillo named Rodrigo Sandoval as its next chief financial officer after long-serving incumbent Mario Arreguin informed the board of his retirement.
The Mexican miner said Monday that Sandoval will join the company on Sept. 21 and take his position on the executive committee in November following a handover period.
Sandoval was previously CFO of Grupo Gigante and the mining division of Grupo Mexico. He was also previously an independent director at Torex Gold Resources.
Current CFO Arreguin said he plans to retire after a 37-year career at the group, Fresnillo said. He will remain with the company as a senior advisor from Nov. 1 until the end of January 2027.
